description: This file contains functions and logic for identifying, validating, and upgrading firmware images for a specific platform, particularly related to the bcm47xx architecture. It includes functions for reading firmware headers, matching device models, and performing image upgrades.

methods.name: get_magic_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and outputs the hexadecimal string.

methods.name: get_le_long_at
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes from a file at a specified offset and outputs as a little-endian long number.

methods.name: platform_expected_image
methods.description: Returns the expected model identifier string for the current device based on its model.

methods.name: bcm47xx_identify
methods.description: Identifies the firmware image type based on magic numbers at specific offsets.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the given firmware image matches the device and is valid for upgrade.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_chk_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract the TRX firmware from a chk image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_cybertan_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract the TRX firmware from a CyberTAN image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxl_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command to extract the TRX firmware from a Luxul image.

methods.name: platform_trx_from_lxlold_cmd
methods.description: Generates a command for older Luxul images.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade using the appropriate extraction command based on identified image type.
